title: Former Nickelodeon Star Christy Knowings Dies at 46
summary: Former child star Christy Knowings, known for her work on Nickelodeon, has died at the age of 46. Her death followed an asthma attack that reportedly caused brain damage. Knowings was a prominent figure during her time on the children's television network.
summary_points: Christy Knowings, a former Nickelodeon child star, died at age 46.
Her death occurred after an asthma attack.
The asthma attack reportedly led to brain damage.
Knowings was a known figure from her time on Nickelodeon.
